written_before_any_ladder_kpi: 2026-11-13T11:0xZ — the D=10 KPIs of A1/A2/A4 and the two measured blow-ups (A3, A5) already exist in runs/ and are KNOWN; they are used only as the baseline rung, never as a target to tune towards. No D=14 / D=20 KPI existed when this file was written (verified: runs/ contained A1_D10, A2_D10, A3_D10, A4_D10, A5_D10 only).
decision: Is the round-2 method-selection verdict (H1 rejected: the OSS selection is not portable within 15 %) itself resolution-limited? Concretely: (a) are the D=10 KPIs of A1/A2/A4 converged, (b) does the A1-vs-A2 gap survive refinement, (c) is A1's >=15 % offset from the external trend band a discretisation artifact, and (d) is the literal-OSS TRT blow-up (A3/A5) a resolution artifact?
alternatives: L_conv: the D=10 KPIs are converged (successive-rung delta < conv_pct) => the round-2 verdict stands as resolution-independent, and the A1 offset is a modelling/physics offset, not a grid offset

L_limited: at least one KPI moves >= conv_pct between rungs => the D=10 KPIs are resolution-limited; the round-2 verdict must be restated as 'resolution-limited, delta at D=10' and the resolution-free value must be extrapolated
L_flip: the A1-vs-A2 delta shrinks below 15 % under refinement => the round-2 rejection of H1 is falsified by refinement (a real, publishable negative result)

hypothesis.H_conv (primary): for every arm in {A1, A2, A4} and every KPI in {cd_mean_last50, st_fft, cl_amp}, |KPI(D=20) - KPI(D=14)| / |KPI(D=14)| < 10 % (the pre-existing conv_pct threshold in summary.json, NOT set here after seeing data)
hypothesis.H_gap: the A1-vs-A2 |Delta| on cd_mean_last50 stays >= 15 % at D=14 and D=20 if and only if the collision-operator knob is a genuine selection variable (if it collapses below 15 %, the round-2 rejection is a grid artifact)
hypothesis.H_fail_persists: the A3/A5 TRT blow-up recurs at D=14 (the literal OSS magic Lambda stays outside the tau_minus window because tau_minus = 0.5 + Lambda/(tau_plus-0.5) grows as tau_plus shrinks; at D=14 tau_plus = 0.5105 gives tau_minus(A3) = 18.36, still >> 2)

outcome_metrics.cd_mean_last50: mean Cd over the last 50 % of the post-warm-up window (primary drag metric)
outcome_metrics.st_fft: Strouhal from the Hann-windowed lift spectrum, parabolic peak

unit_of_analysis: one completed arm x resolution; KPIs are scalars per run

baseline_control.ladder_rungs: D=14 and D=20 for A1 (MRT+sponge, recorded TensorLBM selection), A2 (BGK, OSS selection), A4 (MRT, sponge off = sponge-isolated control)
baseline_control.failure_probe: A3 (TRT magic Lambda) and A5 (TRT Lambda re-derived, tau_minus=2.0) at D=14, run only to test H_fail_persists; they are not part of the KPI ladder because they have no D=10 KPI
baseline_control.external_caliber: unchanged from round 2: trend band Cd [1.30,1.45], St [0.16,0.18], NON-adjudicating (primary Norberg/Sohankar Re=200 table is WITHHELD in this environment)

thresholds_predeclared.provenance: conv_pct / accept_pct / st_xcheck_pct are copied verbatim from summary.json thresholds written in round 2 (2026-11-13T08:10Z), i.e. before any ladder data existed; they are not re-tuned here
thresholds_predeclared.extrapolation_rule: report a 1/D Richardson-style linear fit (KPI = KPI_inf + c/D) over the three rungs as CONTEXT only; the fitted KPI_inf is never used as a PASS/FAIL number, only to say whether the trend band becomes reachable

variables_changed.controlled: Re = 200, blockage D/H = 1/20, domain 20D x 20D, square centre 6D, U = 0.05 (Ma = 0.0866), collision operator and sponge flag per arm, force sampler, post-processing, seeding amplitude 10 % at St_seed = 0.13, 2 seed periods + 15 shedding periods
variables_changed.confounder_declared: at fixed U and Re, the lattice viscosity nu = U D / Re grows with D => tau = 0.5 + 3 nu moves 0.5075 -> 0.5105 -> 0.5150 across the ladder. So the ladder changes grid resolution and tau together (standard fixed-U refinement, NOT diffusive scaling). The trend is therefore 'refinement + less compressibility error'; it can establish convergence but cannot separate the two error sources. Declared, not corrected.
variables_changed.second_confounder: the shedding period in lattice steps grows like D/U, so total step counts differ per rung (21259 / 29763 / 42518); the post-warm-up window is the same fraction (last 50 %) of a run whose length is 15 shedding periods, so the spectral resolution of St is unchanged

repetition_rationale: the round-2 determinism audit proved the harness is bit-reproducible (max|dFx| = 1.78e-14 on a 4000-step re-run; artifacts/m17627_audit), so each rung is run ONCE and reproducibility is asserted by the existing determinism evidence rather than by duplicated runs. The St cross-estimator spread (St_fft vs St_zc, < 5 % predeclared) serves as the within-run uncertainty measure.

analysis_plan: for each arm: rung table (D=10/14/20) of the four KPIs, successive ladders deltas in %, H_conv verdict by the 10 % rule; the A1-vs-A2 delta recomputed at each rung for the H_gap verdict; the failure probes reported as fail.json with step and tau_minus; Richardson-style 1/D fit reported as context. an arm exceeding 3600 s wall clock is recorded as honest not_run; the ladder is then reported with the rungs that exist and the missing rung named
no threshold is changed after seeing a KPI; any post-hoc arm is labelled post-hoc
exclusions: A3/A5 excluded from the KPI ladder (no D=10 KPI, they blow up); the external band stays non-adjudicating; no claim about 3-D behaviour
